properties.displayName: AVD Session Host 利用不可
properties.description: Session Host が Available 以外の状態になった場合にアラート

allOf.query:
WVDAgentHealthStatus
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
            | where Status != "Available"
            | summarize count() by SessionHostName, Status

properties.displayName: AVD ユーザー入力遅延 高
properties.description: ユーザー入力遅延が 2000ms を超えた場合にアラート (UX 劣化の兆候)

allOf.query:
Perf
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
            | where ObjectName == "User Input Delay per Session"
            | where CounterName == "Max Input Delay"
            | summarize AvgDelay = avg(CounterValue) by Computer
            | where AvgDelay > 2000

properties.displayName: FSLogix プロファイルロード遅延
properties.description: FSLogix プロファイルのロード時間が 30秒を超えた場合にアラート

allOf.query:
Perf
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
            | where ObjectName == "FSLogix Apps"
            | where CounterName == "Profile Load Time (ms)"
            | summarize AvgLoadTime = avg(CounterValue) by Computer
            | where AvgLoadTime > 30000

properties.description: AVD への接続が失敗した場合にアラート

allOf.query:
WVDConnections
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
            | where State == "Failed"
            | summarize FailureCount = count() by CorrelationId, UserName
